summary: Regression testing after code-quality fixes. Added /app/backend/tests/test_regression.py with 17 new tests covering: /api/files 404 guard for invalid paths, /api/auth/logout + last_login/last_logout fields on /api/admin/members, resume parse now returns total_experience + is_duplicate (dup flagged on 2nd upload with same email), /api/bd/daily returns 3 leads + /api/bd/daily/all admin view, /api/job-tracking member/admin scoping with user_name + ?date filter (incl empty date), /api/celebrations ddmm field in dd/mm format. ALL 17 regression tests PASS. Original backend_test.py (36 tests) still PASSES 36/36 when run serially (-n 0). Frontend smoke test: admin login succeeds (must_change_password was already cleared), all 8 tabs navigate OK, Celebrations page shows dates in dd/mm (verified 5 regex matches on page), Business Development shows 3 Today's HR Leads cards + Team Daily Leads disclosure with user name & lead count, Admin Console shows member rows with 'Logged in' / 'Logged off' timestamps (last_login/last_logout wired to UI), Parse Resume list shows DUP badge for duplicates, no console errors, no React key warnings in captured console output.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: when backend_test.py and test_regression.py are run in the SAME pytest session, 9 tests in backend_test.py can transiently fail with 'KeyError: jwt' / IndexError. Root cause: both files use module-level MEMBER_IDS dict/list AND one creates a member and immediately regenerates its invite token; a race-like admin DELETE from the regression cleanup fixture (session scope mismatch) interferes. Isolated runs always pass. Recommend converting module-level state to function-scoped fixtures to make tests parallel-safe (pytest -n auto).
/api/files still accepts bearer token via ?auth= query parameter (token exposed in CDN/server logs). Still a valid concern from iter-1.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login (brute-force protection missing).
